title: Miles Todd delivers a brand new single, "Never Give Up."
htmlContent:
The talented artist and songwriter Miles Todd shares a brand new track, "Never Give Up," from the album Peter Pan Syndrome. Miles Todd is one of the most contemporary rising music superstars. He can combine genres in a way that feels so effortless.

The single "Never Give Up," the last song from his album Peter Pan Syndrome highlights the feeling of never giving up in the music. This song is just the beginning of his journey and already shows his ability to craft a song that reaches many people.

Stream Miles Todd's "Never Give Up" on Spotify.
